Ground-truth ASINs, target titles, and evaluator-derived cards are development labels. They are not available in private evaluation.
Optimize HitRate@10 and MRR first; MTTC rewards early identification. Break results out by all four scenarios.
Embedding design decisions supported by the data
Use field-labelled text: title, leaf categories, features, details, description, store.
Dense models need semantic context; BM25 needs exact nouns, brands, materials, sizes, and category tokens.
Keep at least title/category and attributes/description views, or use late-interaction reranking.
Target products have complete titles/features/details, but only part have descriptions; one monolithic vector can dilute exact attributes.
Embed only active positive requirements; store negative, superseded, and no-preference slots separately.
Intent Override and Boundary sessions punish stale or invented constraints.
Fuse BM25 + dense + structured filters, then rerank a modest candidate set.
Buying messages expose exact constraints early; browsing begins vague and benefits from semantic retrieval and clarification.
Use preference tags as soft query-side priors, never as hard product filters.
Profiles are aggregate and recurring, but the current session must override them.
Report performance by scenario and difficulty, plus ablations for field text and profile/context inclusion.
A single aggregate score can hide override and boundary failures.

Scope note: exhaustive conversation text is combinatorial because replies depend on the agent's prior questions. The Branches sheet enumerates every allowed next-question branch from the initial state, plus the post-boundary state; the Scenario Playbook defines the full control-flow rules through turn 10.

In modern usage a camisole or cami is a loose-fitting sleeveless woman's undergarment which covers the top part of the body but is shorter than a chemise. A camisole normally extends to the waist but is sometimes cropped to expose the midriff, or extended to cover the entire pelvic region. Camisoles are manufactured from light materials, commonly cotton-based, occasionally satin or silk, or stretch fabrics such as lycra, nylon, or spandex. A camisole typically has thin "spaghetti straps" and can be worn over a brassiere or without one. Since 1989, some camisoles have come with a built-in underwire bra or other support which eliminates the need for a bra among those who prefer one. Recently, camisoles have been known to be used as outerwear. • 80 Buying + 80 Browsing sessions mean the retriever must work both before and after clarification.
• 30 Intent Override sessions require active/superseded slot status and full-catalog re-retrieval.
• 10 Boundary sessions make no-preference a first-class state, not missing data.
• Profile tags are heavily concentrated in fit, material, comfort, and style: useful soft priors, weak hard filters.
• Target titles, features, details, categories, ratings, and stores are complete; descriptions and prices are not.
• Encode field labels and preserve exact tokens; use dense semantics to complement—not replace—lexical retrieval.

Baseline context
HitRate@10 12.5% | MRR 0.0680 | MTTC 9.81 | Technical score 0.10671
Use these only as the shipped weak-BM25 benchmark; measure every embedding or reranking change against the same public split and by scenario.

Leakage guard
The target ASIN, target title, derived intent card, and exact first message in this workbook exist for public-set study. At runtime, your agent receives only the aggregate user profile and the current simulated customer message.
